verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's marketing describes built-in AI that takes on work: an AI code reviewer that reviews all changes and suggests fixes, and AI-powered pipeline workflows for chores like cleaning up feature flags, updating docs, drafting release notes and fixing flaky tests. Delegation runs through PR review and pipeline triggers rather than an interactive assistant inside the product, and Rovo is placed in the terminal or IDE, not the Bitbucket UI. missing for 10: an interactive in-product assistant for ad-hoc delegation, in-depth documentation of how tasks are delegated and controlled, independent or hands-on corroboration.
